summary: Phase 149O.20K -- HMIC Class-B Verifier Source-Scope Contract Evolution: addresses CBV-S1 by evolving HMIC-001 from v1.2 to v1.3, contract evolution only, no production change. Independently reconstructed HMIC-REQ-052 from the contract document directly (not from prior-phase summaries): at v1.2, its two existing closure limbs bind a PCAE-owned file only if reachable from assess_hatp_mandatory_activation_readiness's call graph (limb a) or the certification/admin ceremony call graph (limb b); direct source search confirmed neither reaches verify_class_b_deployment_conformance or its two sub-verifiers anywhere in production -- a genuine v1.2 scope gap, not an oversight. Independently reconstructed the live production 25-file/5-contract-identity set from hatp_mandatory_certification.py directly (_FROZEN_SRC_PCAE_RELATIVE_FILES 19 entries + _FROZEN_REPOSITORY_ROOT_RELATIVE_FILES 6 entries, live assert len==25), confirmed byte-identical to the pre-amendment HMIC-REQ-050 text. Built a fresh AST-based import-dependency graph rooted independently at all three Class-B verifier modules (hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py, hatp_environment_lock_verifier.py, hatp_class_b_conformance.py): found exactly one PCAE-owned dependency beyond the three roots and the already-bound hatp_bootstrap.py/repository_identity.py -- pcae.core.paths (HarnessPath), used only as an inert path value type, independently classified non-authority-sensitive (Category B) and excluded, reapplying the identical precedent the contract's own text already names for limbs (a)/(b) (pcae.core.paths was already named as an excluded dependency there). Zero fourth PCAE-owned module reached by any import statement; zero dynamic imports found by text search; zero runtime reads of any contract document's bytes by any of the three modules. Full src/ text search for the three module names and verify_class_b_deployment_conformance/verify_class_b_topology_conformance/verify_environment_lock_conformance, excluding the island itself, returned zero matches -- zero production consumers, reconfirming CBV-S1's current safety precondition and confirming this phase introduces no new consumer; hatp_mandatory_cutover.py and human_approval_trusted_provenance.py were separately confirmed to reference only the unrelated string/concept 'Class-B' (CBV-S10's own pre-existing readiness terms), never the verifier island's symbols; no hidden or parallel Class-B decision logic found elsewhere in production. Traced the aggregator (hatp_class_b_conformance.py, which calls both sub-verifiers plus its own _check_model_a_deployment/_check_deployment_identity through shared _aggregate_status/_build_result primitives) and both sub-verifiers for every dependency capable of altering the COMPLIANT/NON_COMPLIANT/INDETERMINATE verdict -- all three modules genuinely self-contained apart from already-covered imports; all thirty-nine of the topology verifier's top-level defs confirmed local via direct grep inventory. Cycle/self-binding check: hatp_environment_lock_verifier.py's _AUTHORITY_MODULE_RELATIVE_PATHS is a hand-reproduced 19-entry literal data constant, independently confirmed via AST walk to contain zero Import/ImportFrom nodes naming hatp_mandatory_certification or hatp_certification_admin anywhere in the three verifier modules, and confirmed neither of those two files imports any of the three verifier modules -- no HMIC validator/admin self-reference, no digest-construction cycle, no Class-B-verifier-to-HMIC-verifier-to-Class-B-verifier recursion; W-1 not reopened (concerns a distinct file pair with no import relationship to this phase's three files). Regression-confirmed B-149O.19.3-1's four provider files (hatp_providers.py, hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_piv_provider.py, hatp_hardware_credentials.py) and B-149O.20D-1's HBDC-001 binding both remain present, unremoved, unmodified in the live production constants. Added new HMIC-REQ-052 closure limb (c), anchored at verify_class_b_deployment_conformance's own call graph, explicitly anticipatory (binds authority-sensitive source before any consumer exists, mirroring limb (b)'s own v1.1 precedent) -- zero production consumers explicitly stated in the limb's own text. Widened HMIC-REQ-050's frozen enumeration from 25 to 28 files (the three Class-B verifier modules, all src/pcae/-relative, appended after the existing 19 src/pcae/-relative entries) -- derived as the result of the closure walk above, not assumed in advance; excluded-dependency rationale (pcae.core.paths, Category B) recorded explicitly in the contract text. Widened the attack matrix from 37 to 38 scenarios: new row 38 (Class-B verifier byte modification while HMIC identity unchanged), 'not yet operative, and not yet consequential' per the identical convention already established for attacks #33/#34/#36/#37 -- contractually mandated but neither mechanically enforced (production still computes the 25-file digest) nor functionally load-bearing (zero production consumers exist). Threat analysis: incomplete binding (omitting any one of the three files leaves a channel by which the aggregate verdict can change while every bound file's digest stays identical -- closure would be violated) and over-binding (pcae.core.paths excluded specifically to avoid unnecessary digest volatility; git/ls/the interpreter cannot be brought into HMIC scope by naming a PCAE file) both worked explicitly, not assumed. Version-bump determination: this amendment matches the v1.0-to-v1.1 shape (widened HMIC-REQ-050/052 by adding a limb and files), not a same-version repair like 149O.20D.1 -- HMIC-001 v1.2 to v1.3, an in-place minor bump, following the repository's own established convention (v1.0-to-v1.1, v1.1-to-v1.2 precedent), not v2.0 (no existing field/schema/algorithm redefined or removed). Added new contract section 53 'Contract Amendment History -- Phase 149O.20K (v1.3)' (subsections 53.1 through 53.14) documenting the full reconstruction, dependency graph, classification (Categories A through E), aggregator/sub-verifier semantics, cycle analysis, B-149O.19.3-1/B-149O.20D-1 regressions, threat analysis, target-set derivation, contract-version determination, and verdict. Explicitly did NOT update production's _FROZEN_AUTHORITY_BEARING_FILES/_CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FILES (still 25/5, intentionally, disclosed-ly stale relative to the contract's new 28/5 target, mirroring the identical contract-ahead-of-production sequencing already established at v1.1 -- 149O.19.5E.1 -- and v1.2/149O.20D.1 -- 149O.20D followed by 149O.20F); did not wire verify_class_b_deployment_conformance's result into any readiness/certification/activation code path; did not touch CBV-S10, readiness schemas, Permission Broker, POL-005, COMP-002, or Runtime Enforcement; did not provision Class-B. New test module tests/test_phase_149o_20k_hmic_class_b_verifier_source_scope_contract_evolution.py (40 tests, all passing) independently re-verifies the contract text AND, separately, re-derives -- via a second, independently-written AST walk, not merely trusting the contract's own prose -- zero production consumers, no import cycle, and bounded PCAE-owned imports across all three verifier modules; also confirms HBDC-001 and the four other pre-existing bound contracts byte-unchanged, no src/pcae or scripts file dirty, production still 25/5, and no real certification state anywhere in the repository. Targeted HMIC/HBDC/Class-B/149O.20* sweep (pytest -k 'hmic or hbdc or class_b or 149o_20'): baseline (git-stashed) 47 failed/1 error/1522 passed; post-phase 86 failed/10 errors/1514 passed; exact node-ID diff via comm confirms zero previously-failing nodes fixed or newly passing, exactly 50 new failing/error nodes, every one traced to a prior phase's own 'contract byte-unchanged since phase entry'/'live enumeration currently equals N files'/'attack matrix currently has N rows' self-check across 14 historical test files spanning 149O.14/149O.19.4/149O.19.5B/149O.19.5E.3/149O.19.5E.4/149O.1G/149O.20A/149O.20C/149O.20D/149O.20D.1/149O.20E/149O.20F/149O.20G/149O.20H -- the identical structural breakage pattern every prior HMIC version bump (v1.0-to-v1.1, v1.1-to-v1.2) produced against its own predecessors' live-text/git-diff self-checks (independently confirmed for one representative case: test_phase_149o_1g_hatp_proof_models_canonical_serialization.py::test_hatp_contract_byte_unchanged fails on a bare 'git diff docs/contracts/' self-check with no file-name pin, meaning it fails for any contract edit whatsoever by construction, not specifically because of this phase's content). None of these 14 historical files are within this phase's allowed-file scope. Full Fast Green (pytest -m fast_green -n auto, fido2 module ignored -- pre-existing/unrelated): baseline (git-stashed) 71 failed/6771 passed/5 skipped/1 error; post-phase 112 failed/6761 passed/5 skipped/10 errors; exact node-ID diff confirms zero fixed, exactly 50 new nodes, the identical set from the targeted sweep. Clean-deselected citation (122-node argv-list --deselect per exact raw node ID, not shell string interpolation): 1 failed (tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_audit_verify_cli, the same pytest-xdist -n auto ordering flake 149O.20J.8's own report already documented -- confirmed passing cleanly 7/7 in an isolated rerun of the entire TestAuditPersistence class), 6760 passed, 5 skipped, 1 pre-existing collection error; a separate, independent tests/test_backend_cli.py::TestBackendReviewReject::test_reject_json_no_secrets flake was also observed on one earlier deselected run and confirmed passing cleanly in isolation -- both flakes are order/parallelism-dependent, reproduced independently across multiple runs with different single nodes flipping, and touch neither HMIC/Class-B/contract logic nor any file this phase modified. Governed lifecycle: closed the stale post-149O.20J.8 idle placeholder task, opened a fresh governed task 20260813-0847-phase-149o-20k-... with only the contract file, new phase document, new test file, and status/changelog/task-lifecycle artifacts allowed; the three Class-B/environment-lock production modules, HBDC-001, and the production HMIC source-set implementation explicitly forbidden and confirmed untouched throughout. Committed via pcae commit implementation (commit 3e1137ef) -- staged-file-aware, explicit --path per file, no raw git commit, no --no-verify, no force push. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20K_HMIC_CLASS_B_VERIFIER_SOURCE_SCOPE_CONTRACT_EVOLUTION.md documenting all required verification areas. Updated PROJECT_STATUS.md (demoting 149O.20J.8 to a new stacked Previous Phase entry) and CHANGELOG.md. CBV-S1: OPEN -- HMIC SOURCE-SCOPE CONTRACT EVOLVED -- PRODUCTION ALIGNMENT AND INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PENDING -- NOT CLOSED (contract amendment alone does not close it). CBV-S10: OPEN -- READINESS CONTRACT/INTEGRATION GAP (unchanged, untouched). Class-B: CONTRACT VERIFIED -- VERIFIER REPAIR LINE INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- HMIC SOURCE-SCOPE CONTRACT EVOLVED -- PRODUCTION ALIGNMENT PENDING -- NOT PROVISIONED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable.
